Noor Alam ----- Defendant No. 3-Appellant
Vs
Sonali Bank & others ----- Plaintiff-Respondent
full_judgment: 2. Relevant facts of the case, in short, are that the respondent No.1, Sonali Bank as plaintiff filed a suit being Title Suit No.145 of 1999 in the Court of Sub-ordinate Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka impleading the present appellant Noor Alam and 2(two) others as defendants for realization of its outstanding dues amounting to Taka 4,43,888.50 with interest. The plaintiff's case in short, is that, the defendant No. 2 approached to the plaintiff-Bank vide his application dated 9-9-80 for issuance of a Bank Guarantee for Taka 6,50,000 for a period of one year to transact the normal business of defendant No.1 with Bangladesh Biman offering 15 Kathas of land as counter guarantee which valued at Taka 15,00,000 under Mouza Gulshan adjacent to Road No. 8 in Gulshan Model Town owned by the defendant No. 2, the proprietor of defendant No.1; that defendant No.3 vide his letter dated 15,9,1980 also prayed to the plaintiff-Bank to issue a Bank Guarantee for Taka 6,50,000 on behalf of the defendant No.1 of which defendant No. 2 is the proprietor offering his immovable property measuring 7½ Kathas of land with three-storied residential building situated thereon under Khatian No. 135 (New) and CS Khatian No. 14774 and C.S plot No. 28 in sheet No. 49 as described in the schedule 'B' of the plaint as security of the said Bank Guarantee; that the plaintiff-Bank through its Eskaton Road. Branch vide letter No. Eska/ BG-80/4 /1423 dated 1-10-1980 issued Bank Guarantee for Taka 6,50,000 for a period up-to 30th September, 1981 as required by them and thereupon, the defendant Nos. 2 and 3 mortgaged their property in favour of the plaintiff-bank as described in the schedule of the plaint; that on 22-11-1981 Bangladesh Biman, the beneficiary of the aforesaid Bank Guarantee, requested its Banker at Ramna Branch of the plaintiff-Bank to collect the amount of Taka 4,91,980/99 against the aforesaid Bank Guarantee for Taka 6,50,00.0 from the Eskaton Road Branch of the plaintiff-Bank and thereupon, the plaintiff-Bank on various occasions asked the defendant No. 2, to do the needful regarding the claim of the beneficiary Bangladesh Biman. The defendant No.2 instead of regularizing the Account filed a suit being TS No. 37 of 1981 in the Court of 3rd Sub-ordinate Judge, Dhaka for Temporary injunction restraining the plaintiff-Bank and the beneficiary-Bangladesh Biman, from encashing the Bank Guarantee dated 28-2-81 and obtained an order of status-quo with regard to encashment of the Bank Guarantee; that ultimately the aforesaid order of status-quo was vacated by the learned Sub-ordinate Judge Court, Dhaka vide order dated 29-7-81 and thereupon, unsuccessful-plaintiff filed Miscellaneous Appeal No. 329 of 1981 in the Court of the leaned District Judge, Dhaka; that during the pendency of the aforesaid Misc. Appeal No. 329 of 1981 in the , Court of District Judge, Dhaka MLO No 14 was promulgated on 22nd April, 1982 and consequent thereupon by an order of the learned District Judge, Dhaka dated 28-6-1982 the aforesaid Misc. Appeal was struck off; that the defendant No. 1 was required to make marginal deposit of Taka 3,25,000 out of which Taka 2,61,000 was given by a cheque of Agrani Bank, Ramna branch against current account of the wife of the defendant No. 2 which was dishonored twice by the Bank. In spite of repeated reminder letters issued by the plaintiff bank to the defendant No. 2 for payment against the Bank Guarantee, nothing was done. Under this facts and circumstances the plaintiff-Bank was compelled to pay Taka 4,91,980.99 to the beneficiary, Bangladesh Biman on 17-10-82 under obligation for the Bank Guarantee on behalf of the defendant No. 1. Hence the suit.
